sketches.mechanism: Ownership transfer (move semantics) — after giving a value to someone, the original binding can no longer use it
sketches.resonance: Giving yourself to another means you no longer have yourself; Rust's borrow checker enforces the irreversibility of devotion.

sketches.mechanism: method_missing — called when an object receives a message it doesn't understand, allowing infinite unanswered calls
sketches.resonance: No matter what you say to grief, it has no answer — it simply echoes your attempt back as silence.
sketches.draft:
class Grief
  def method_missing(*)
    self
  end
end

sketches.mechanism: A final variable that is declared but never initialized inside a branch, causing a compile error — the language refuses to allow the possibility of emptiness
sketches.resonance: A promise you only conditionally keep cannot compile; Java insists that what is declared final must be filled with certainty.
